title: What's The Weather: Rebroadcasted
description: A remake of What's The Weather. It allows you to craft TVs that show the current weather on them.
body:
What's the weather Rebroacsted is a... remastered version of Whats the weather, duh. It adds 2 whole TVs that can be used both to tell the time AND as decoration! And, it is now way more optimized! You may be thinking "Why would i use this? Can't i just look outside?". You could... unless  you live underground, in another dimension, or don't want to look outside every night and are waiting for a thunder storm.

Also, I have a feedback form now! Check it out [here](https://forms.gle/yoqKg2okEsmqeWFx6)!
